name: multistorey-panels-f13
description: v0.31.5.381 visual verification: on the two-storey Open Loft with furniture on the upper level, the Budget panel's 'Spend by room' must credit the loft room, and the Layers panel must group the upstairs rooms. Pro mode.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: load-loft-plan
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__loadErr=null; import('/src/floorplan/templates.ts').then(m => { const plan = m.PLAN_TEMPLATES.find(p => p.id === 'tpl-loft'); if (!plan) throw new Error('tpl-loft not in PLAN_TEMPLATES'); window.__store.getState().replaceFloorPlan(plan, { furniture: 'rehome' }); }).catch(e => { window.__loadErr = String(e); }); })()

steps.name: put-furniture-on-the-loft
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const its=s.items; const picks=its.slice(0,4).map(i=>i.id); const set=new Set(picks); s.setItems(its.map(it => set.has(it.id) ? { ...it, levelId:'lf-up', position:[1.0+picks.indexOf(it.id)*0.6, 4.2] } : it)); })()

steps.name: assert-loft-in-spend-by-room
steps.eval: (function(){ const lbl=[...document.querySelectorAll('.label')].find(e=>/Spend by room/.test(e.textContent||'')); if(!lbl) throw new Error('Spend by room block not found'); const block=lbl.parentElement; const txt=block?.textContent||''; if(!/Sleeping Loft/.test(txt)) throw new Error('Spend by room omits the loft room — upstairs items were bucketed as Outside rooms. Got: '+txt.slice(0,300)); lbl.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()

steps.name: enter-the-UPSTAIRS-room-editor
steps.note: The catalog/Layers drawer only mounts on an editing surface. Entering an UPSTAIRS room also exercises .277's editableRooms fix.

steps.name: layers-visible
steps.failMessage: the Layers panel never listed the upstairs room — it grouped by plan.rooms (ground only)

steps.name: collapse-all-groups
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.lyr-showall,button')].find(b=>/Collapse all/i.test(b.textContent||'')); if(!btn) throw new Error('Collapse all button not found'); btn.click(); })()
steps.note: Otherwise the ground room's 32 rows push every upstairs group off-screen and the shot shows nothing that was asserted.

steps.name: assert-loft-group-has-items
steps.eval: (function(){ const body=document.querySelector('.lyr-body'); if(!body) throw new Error('.lyr-body not rendered'); const groups=[...body.querySelectorAll('.lyr-group')]; const names=groups.map(g=>(g.querySelector('.lyr-ghead-row')?.textContent||'').trim()); const idx=names.findIndex(n=>/Sleeping Loft/i.test(n)); if(idx<0) throw new Error('the Layers tree has no Sleeping Loft group — grouped by plan.rooms (ground only). Groups: '+names.join(' | ')); const other=names.findIndex(n=>/Stair Landing|Dressing/i.test(n)); groups[idx].scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); window.__layerGroups=names.join(' | '); window.__otherUpper=other; })()
